Stop the convergence holding a workspace, through its one cancel door: what is in flight finishes, everything not yet started is abandoned, and the convergence ends 'cancelled'. A cancel still finishing at the server's deadline returns the stage the convergence is at with cancelling true; apply with its convergence_id follows it to its end. It is named by its workspace (workspace_alias), not by a convergence_id. Works whether or not this server is following it (one an earlier server started is reached from the workspace).

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | true |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
| `cause` | string | no | Why, recorded on the convergence. |
